title: stainless steel drink picks
text: stainless steel drink picks. You get 2 different lengths... one set longer, one set shorter... a ball at one end and a very sharp poke at the other.  I am just a little disappointed that they are so thin and seem a little flimsy - hope they hold up.  The thing is - they are sooo thin that I doubt you can load much more than 2 olives on either length.

product_metadata.title: A Bar Above Short Rose Gold Cocktail Picks – Metal Stir Sticks for Drink Garnish, Bloody Mary Skewers, Shrimp Cocktail & More – Stainless-Steel Cocktail Toothpicks for Appetizers – (12 pcs)

Premium Material: These cocktail garnish sticks are made of professional food-grade stainless steel 304 that will last a lifetime! This cocktail pick set should be hand washed and will be easy to clean over and over while still keeping its polished copper finish. You will never have to throw away disposable picks again!

Ideal for Short Cocktails: Our cocktail toothpicks are specifically designed for short glasses so you can use them as skewers for your Gin & Tonic, Old-Fashioned, and Cosmopolitan or as Martini picks for olives. Use these Bloody Mary skewers to enjoy your cocktail garnish, cherries, pineapple, lemon slices, shrimp cocktail, or blue cheese stuffed olives.

Must-Have Bartender Accessories: These metal cocktail picks for drinks are essential bar tools in some of the world’s best restaurants and top bartender competitions. Include these garnish picks for cocktails in your bar supplies and accessories for home, charcuterie accessories, mini bar, or catering business.
